source.placeholder: design rule: courtyards of two parts keep at least 0.25 mm (IPC-7351B adds 0.25 mm courtyard excess at density level B; this is the gap between two courtyards, so pads of neighbours are about 0.75 mm apart)
design rule: a decoupling capacitor's supply pad is at most 2.5 mm (pad edge to pad edge) from the pin it serves; SPEC 8 allows 3 mm, the placer keeps 0.5 mm of margin
design rule: courtyards keep 0.5 mm from the board edge (JLCPCB needs copper 0.2 mm from the routed edge, capabilities page)
design rule: no extra room around ICs (courtyard_clearance_mm applies); a board that needs escape routing raises it

source.placeholder: design rule (SPEC 8: the analog output routes away from the STEP / DIR pairs): 3 mm edge to edge between an analog-class track and a differential pair
design rule: the track from a decoupling capacitor's supply pad to its IC pin is at most 6 mm long (0.2 mm of the 0.4 mm / 3 mm placement distance plus the fan-out)
design rule: the via that takes a decoupling capacitor's ground pad to the plane is at most 2.5 mm from the pad
design rule: at least 80 % of a pair's length runs at its gap (the rest is the fan-out at the ends)
design rule: the two tracks of a differential pair differ by at most 2 mm (13 ps at 6.7 ps/mm; a 10 Mbit/s driver has 20 ns edges)
design rule: a class that carries 0.5 A or more uses the large via, the others the signal via
design rule: a class that needs more than 0.8 mm on the inner copper stays on the outer layers
design rule: 1.5 x the IPC-2221 width (the formulas are for a free-standing track and carry a +-10 % scatter)
design rule: power and ground links at least 0.3 mm (1.5 x the signal width: less drop, a via fits on the track)

design rule: 0.15 mm spacing (JLCPCB minimum 0.09 mm, capabilities page)
design rule: 0.4 mm / 0.2 mm drill vias (JLCPCB 4-layer minimum 0.25 / 0.15 mm, capabilities page: a ring of 0.1 mm)
design rule: 0.2 mm drill (JLCPCB 4-layer minimum 0.15 mm)
design rule: 0.2 mm signal tracks (JLCPCB minimum 0.09 mm; 0.2 mm keeps yield and leaves room between 1.27 mm pitch pads)
